bibl.title: Five Nijmegen papyri
bibl.seg: Mark de Kreij & Janneke de Jong, Five Nijmegen Papyri.
bibl.note: All seven of the Nijmegen papyri were bought from von Scherling, in or around 1948. - P. Noviomag. Inv. 1. Fragment of a Ptolemaic document. Provenance unknown, July 10, 261 BCE? - Inv. 3. Account of Grain Transport. Provenance unknown, 2nd century BCE. - Inv. 5. List of Payments by Villages? Oxyrhynchus (?), 1st century CE. - Inv. 6. Account? Provenance unknown, 2nd-1st century BCE. - Inv. 7. Letter to the house of Peteuris. Oxyrhynchus (?), (16-25)th December 76 or 124 CE.
